cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you go, read this dinner bill with me. Start with the item marked 'seafood platter'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can split it tomorrow. My taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That was your 'just a starter'. Read the price before you divide the total; we're settling items, not halves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll transfer whatever it says. Hand me the bill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hold it still, please. Read that line aloud, then make the transfer. I'll confirm it has arrived before you go to the taxi.

reason: Use B's payment offer to move from reading the actual cost to witnessed settlement, with a real departure pressure.
